maya: quick async standup — what I did / blockers / today
maya: did: rolled capacity scripts for standby lanes, validated ams1 + us-west2 mapping, pushed small hotfix to prewarm job (logs look cleaner)
maya: blockers: still seeing sporadic spot evictions in apac-edge (low impact but noisy)
maya: today: finish drain-test runbook updates, follow up on quota bump request for us-west2 reserve

alex: noted — saw the eviction spikes last night, looks correlated to a vintage image that the autoscaler chose
alex: did: repro'd eviction locally, added a fallback to prefer ondemand when spot eviction rate > 5% for the last 30m
alex: todo: coordinate with cloud-reqs to request a small reserved pool for model-warmers in us-west2 (target 8 GPUs)
alex: ping @jen for the PR review on the quota automation change (#INF-4321) :eyes:

jen: on it, will review in the next hour, quick skim looked fine but want to run the infra smoke script first
jen: FWIW please attach the target reservation name in the PR, e.g., `redwood-resv-model-warmers-usw2`
jen: if we can land before EOD we can cutover tomorrow morning pre-traffic :rocket:

sam: FYI I kicked a drain test on nodepool-b this morning, it dropped one lane briefly which triggered a small throttling alert
sam: root cause was a kubelet version skew — fixed by rolling nodepool-b to v1.26.5 (patched)
sam: no customer impact, just noisy op alerts. added a temporary autoscaler override: `minReplicas=2` for the warmers

ops-bot: deploy-bot: [2026-03-18T09:12:04Z] rolling update started for nodepool-b -> image redwood-warm-2026-03-17
ops-bot: deploy-bot: [2026-03-18T09:22:19Z] rolling update completed, 0 failures

lia: adding quota request checklist: cloud console ticket + billing approver + region justification
lia: template I used before: `SUMMARY / JUSTIFICATION / REQUIRED_ZONES / ESTIMATED_DAILY_HOURS / OWNER_CONTACT`
lia: I'll open the USW2 reservation ticket and link it to #INF-4321, tagging finance for billing ok

maya: thanks — alex, can you paste the exact reservation size you want so lia can include in the ticket?
alex: target=8xA10G (or 8xA100 if spot-unfriendly) ; prefer a single AZ spread if possible (us-west2-a then b)

jen: quick heads-up — if we request A100 reserved, approval might take longer (finance sign-off). If timing is tight, request A10G first and schedule an upgrade plan

sam: also adding note: enable prefix KV caching on the warmers so we don't regen cold caches during rollouts — I left a config snippet in the PR comment
sam: snippet: ```yaml
cache:
  prefix_enabled: true
  ttl_seconds: 3600
```

maya: perfect. no other blockers from me. updating the runbook now and will post the link here when done. :white_check_mark:
maya: thanks team — will check back after lia opens the ticket and after jen lands the PR.
